summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $850 million aggregate principal amount of 5.950% notes due 2031. The notes were issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, mature May 15, 2031, pay semi-annual interest, and are general unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing unsecured debt. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration statement and closed on April 27, 2026. The filing is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
